title: Burn Bright, Mad Dog
overview: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

title: Howl, Mad Dog
overview: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

title: Life Back at Home
overview: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

title: A King-Class Water Mage
overview: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

title: Celebrations
overview: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.

title: Another Domestic Disaster?
overview: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.

title: Phase Four
overview: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.

title: The Flying Fortress
overview: Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.

title: Lament
overview: Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.

title: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
overview: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.

title: Turning Point 4
overview: Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.
